capabilities: Sync a vault incrementally to a self-hosted LiteSync server
Encrypt note contents end-to-end with AES-256-GCM before upload
Merge conflicting edits with three-way diff3 and a conflict resolver UI
Browse, compare, and restore immutable per-file versions
Pair new devices via expiring QR links and share notes via revocable encrypted links
extras: Not yet in Community Plugins; manual installation from release files is documented. The server component is a separate open-source project. Chinese documentation is available. The README includes an unusually detailed threat model with explicitly listed undetected attacks and metadata leaks.
problem: Syncing a vault normally means trusting a third-party cloud or hosted service; this runs sync through a server you control, so notes never leave your infrastructure unencrypted.

relations.evidence: and optional Restic → Cloudflare R2 disaster backup

requires.name: Restic and Cloudflare R2 for off-site disaster backup

summary: Self-hosted sync that sends your vault to your own LiteSync server with end-to-end encryption, version history, and automatic Markdown merge.
